title: Add MailBackend::find_thread_by_message_ids to eliminate O(n) scan in assign_thread
description: assign_thread (email.rs) fetches all emails in the account to find a thread match by Message-ID. Fix: add find_thread_by_message_ids(&self, account_id, &[&str]) -> Result<Option<Id>, Self::Error> to MailBackend, implement in MemoryBackend with a scan of only email.message_id fields, and update assign_thread to call it. This is a breaking change to the MailBackend trait — existing implementors must add the method.
